title: Director Brief
description: The director's creative contract for one episode, produced at the brief stage and injected into every downstream agent (v2.5 DIR-01/DIR-06). Seven fields are required: a missing field means the director's intent is unspecified, not that the field is optional.

hook_strategy.description: How the first 2-3 seconds make a stranger stop scrolling: the visible conflict as a shot, not a title card.

emotional_arc.description: The feeling curve across the episode (e.g. tension -> false relief -> gut punch) and where each turn lands.

dramatic_question.description: The one question the audience keeps watching to answer.

pacing_philosophy.description: Rhythm doctrine: where to hold, where to cut, how dead air is treated.

visual_tone.description: Lighting, palette, framing and texture doctrine that keeps the look one film, not a stack of clips.

sound_emotional_curve.description: Music/sound curve (build -> swell -> resolve) the sound_design sub-stage must shape; selected from music_library/ (D20).

audience_emotional_trigger.description: The specific audience feeling this episode is engineered to trigger (guilt, longing, relief...).
